profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Franklin Lakes, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
With over a decade of experience in web development and software engineering, I specialize in crafting scalable, efficient, and user-centric applications. As an Advanced Software Engineer at Kroger Technology until October 2025, I contributed to building innovative orchestration layer applications and reusable UI components while ensuring seamless integration across platforms like Google Cloud, Azure, and on-premise servers. Committed to delivering elegant solutions, I thrive in collaborative environments that prioritize innovation, mentorship, and efficiency.  

At Kroger Technology, I guided teams in adopting best practices for React, Redux, and TypeScript, significantly improving code quality and team workflows. I developed robust orchestration applications, reusable components, and REST APIs to enhance personalized customer experiences. My previous extensive experience with React, Redux, and .NET has strengthened my expertise in creating modular and maintainable web architectures, enabling teams to achieve scalable, user-driven solutions.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Skills: Front-end Coding · Web Application Development · TypeScript · ReactJS

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Provided guidance to junior developers on best practices for React, Redux, and TypeScript, improving code quality and team efficiency
• Develop orchestration layer applications to send and receive data between clients (web, iOS, Android) and backend APIs hosted on Google Cloud Platform, Azure, and on-premise servers
• Integrate and update other teams' codebases to improve reusability and maintainability
• Work in a monolith repository developing reusable Components, Hooks, and utility functions utilized by other teams
• Build dynamic, reusable UI components using React and Redux for front-end web applications
• Develop REST APIs to enhance personalized customer interactions
• Create unit tests using @testing-library/react and @testing-library/jest-dom, following React and React-Redux testing guidelines
• Utilize Kanban methodology to streamline project management and improve workflow
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Redux.js · TypeScript · Microservices · GitHub · Agile Methodologies · JIRA · JavaScript · Web Development

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Design, develop, test, and maintain front-end architecture for company site, www.phillips.com

Utilize Modular-Oriented Pattern built on React, Redux, and SCSS to create scalable web
applications composed by modular class and functional components

Create services, classes, and utility functions while leveraging DRY principles to handle various
user actions, CRUD operations, and 3rd-party hooks

Configure and transpile build with Babel and Webpack to utilize most recent ES features, while
maintaining browser compliance

Highly experienced with .NET stack, develop and maintain Razor views while using
ReactJS.NET for server side rendering, and controllers using C# for .NET Stack

Initiated and developed responsive design implementation for www.phillips.com􀀠 , thereby
improving the company’s mobile web presence

Lead code reviews with junior developers and QA to maintain code readability and adhere to
team standards

Implemented 3rd-party SEO recommendations on HTML architecture and JS data flow

Collaborated with team to create more intuitive mobile UX, and developed improved UI

Created basic build functions on top of NodeJS to improve development workflow

Highly skilled in JIRA, GitFlow, Office 365, and Adobe Suite for open collaboration

positions.title: Salaried Professional Services - Web Developer
positions.description: I develop iPad applications using Xcode.  I utilize HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery to create applications from PSDs.  This application is then wrapped with PhoneGap and processed through Xcode to create an iPad App.

positions.title: Web Development Project Manager
positions.description: I am a project manager for LMBRJCK.  It's a boutique creative agency that focus on web development.  Our clients ranged from small businesses and productions like indie movies to well known entities like New York Times, Casio, and TED Talks.  I work designers, developers and clients to project the scope of work, timeline expectations, budgets, and payment agreement.  I also hire contractors depending on the scope of work.  I  assign responsibilities and communicate frequently and openly with the staff to maintain our project timeline.

positions.title: Study Coordinator
positions.description:
Directed project teams to phone, clinic, and home visits in accordance with research guidelines and study policy.  

Managed accurate entry of more than 3,400 patient data items into SWAN database.

Planned and executed participant appreciation events via coordination with caterers, location vendors, and participants. 

Led weekly project meetings including providing and forecasting status reports using monthly trends.

Coordinated with sister healthcare site directors to facilitate protocol adjustments and rollout.

Developed participant retention tools to find 60% of difficult-to-locate participants

positions.title: PhD Research Assistant
positions.description:
Tested and interviewed medical study participants and conducted performance based measurements.

Developed custom Microsoft Access database to increase ease of use in querying and manipulating information. 

Built trusted relationships with over 160 participants and proxies over tenure at Johns Hopkins.  
Trained staff on study procedures, HIPAA-compliance participant confidentiality terms, Human Subject Research guidelines, and IRB specific protocols.

positions.title: Sales Associate, Electronics
positions.description: Achieved $90,000 in gross sales over Q2-Q3/2005 and led electronics department in overall commission-based sales.
